title: Sheaves supported on finitely many closed points with separably closed residue fields are acyclic
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme with inclusion $j:U\to X$, and assume that $X\setminus U$ is a finite set of closed points [def-weil-closed-points] $x$ each of whose residue fields $\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is separably closed [def-kun-separably-closed]. Let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] whose inverse image $j^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] on $U_{\Et}$ is zero. Then $H^q(X_{\Et},G)=0$ for all $q\ge1$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].
